summary.text: Lynda Schlegel Culver is a Republican who represents Pennsylvania's 27th Senatorial District (Columbia, Luzerne, Montour, Northumberland and Snyder Counties), elected in a January 2023 special election and re-elected in November 2024; she chairs the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate, Culver was elected to seven terms representing the 108th District in the state House of Representatives, and she spent more than 20 years as staff leader in the office of former state Rep. Merle Phillips.
She is a Shikellamy High School graduate and earned a B.A. in political science with a concentration in public administration from Bloomsburg University.

In the Senate she is vice chair of the Health and Human Services Committee and also serves on the Appropriations, Aging & Youth, Consumer Protection & Professional Licensure, Intergovernmental Operations, and Local Government committees.

She is a lifelong resident of Northumberland County, serves on the boards of Central Susquehanna Opportunities, Inc. and the Pennsylvania Higher Education Assistance Agency, and lives in Rockefeller Township with her husband, Tom.
